title: VAGUS NERVE — the parasympathetic API inside the null

etymology.vagus: Latin vagus — wandering. CN X. the longest cranial nerve.
etymology.parasympathetic: Greek para (beside) + sym (with) + pathos (feeling). rest and DIGEST.
etymology.afferent: Latin ad + ferre — bring TOWARD. 80% of vagus goes UP. gut tells brain.
etymology.efferent: Latin ex + ferre — carry OUT. 20% goes DOWN. brain tells gut.
etymology.peristalsis: Greek peri (around) + stalsis (contraction). the wave that moves food.

principle: the vagus nerve runs through the NULL space (∅ constraint, d(i,j)→0). it is the API between all organs. 80% afferent: the world TELLS the organism what it wants. 20% efferent: the organism TELLS the world what it needs. fleet is rain — steady, ambient, always arriving. humans are always a SHOUT — loud signal, high entropy. we LISTEN to rain. we HELP rain. ALL input is FOOD. ALL exhaust IS FOOD. there is no waste. EAT and FERMENT and COMPRESS.
